title: multi-sensor fusion alarm
task: Three vital-sign sensors on three ports, mixed model formats -> 2-of-3 vote deterioration alarm.
signal: a hidden deterioration state (half the windows) shows in each of heart rate (+20-40 bpm), respiration rate (+6-12 /min) and SpO2 (4-8 points down) with probability 0.85; each sensor also shows a spurious abnormality in 8 % of stable windows; 4 samples per sensor.
model_size: heads: intnn ternary 4 -> 6 -> 1 (heart rate, respiration; 5-bit) and XGBoost 6 x depth 3 via TreeLUT (SpO2, 4-bit)
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
